CONTACT & CORRECTIONS

Contact the Pinoy Ball Editorial Desk

Have a question about an NBA matchup preview, a Philippine Time schedule listing, or a statistical correction? Reach our editorial team directly.

Direct Editorial Channels

  • Editorial & Matchup Inquiries: editorial@pinoyball.com
  • Corrections & Archive Verification: Include the matchup URL and official NBA or ESPN box-score reference so we can verify and timestamp updates promptly.
  • Newsroom Location: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines (Operating hours aligned with NBA pregame injury report windows, 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM PHT).

Corrections Policy

Accuracy matters. When a factual error in team records, arena details, or final archive scores is reported and verified against official NBA data, we update the affected page immediately and note the revision in accordance with our editorial revision policy.
